signals.title: "Accept: text/markdown" — a content-negotiation standard for AI agents
signals.summary: New HN-surfaced spec (176 pts) lets any site serve a clean Markdown version of a page when a client sends an Accept: text/markdown header, cutting tokens and DOM noise for AI crawlers/agents without touching the HTML humans see.
signals.run_with_it_note: Add an Accept: text/markdown responder to one FareHarbor/WP-VIP site this week (a small Cloudflare Worker in front of it works, no theme changes needed) and see if it changes how ChatGPT/Perplexity crawl and cite that site. Direct lever for the AI-SEO/GEO work already underway.

signals.title: StemDeck: free, local, open-source audio stem separator
signals.summary: Free desktop app (243 HN pts) splits any audio or video into 6 stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other) locally via Meta's Demucs model. No upload, no account, runs on Mac/Windows/Linux.
signals.run_with_it_note: Run one clip from the boatcam backlog through it this week to strip unlicensed background music before reposting — a real fix for the copyright-strike risk on social clips, and it's free.

signals.title: Sopro V2 Turbo: 120M-parameter voice clone that runs on a laptop CPU
signals.summary: Apache-2.0 zero-shot voice-cloning TTS model clones a voice from a 3-12s clip and streams live on a laptop CPU or in-browser, no GPU, no API bill, SOTA-level intelligibility for its size.
signals.run_with_it_note: Clone one host/captain's voice from an existing video clip and generate a single test voiceover line for a social post this week — a free way to get a consistent narrator voice across channels without hiring VO talent.

signals.title: Perplexity + Nvidia's Portable Computer: fully local AI agent, zero token cost
signals.summary: Still pre-Windows-launch (expected September). This week's only sighting was a passing mention inside a broader HN thread, so momentum has cooled off from launch week even though the underlying zero-token local-agent capability hasn't changed.

signals.title: Slack ships "Big Mode" and "Deep Research" agentic features
signals.summary: Slack's built-in agent adds multi-step agentic analysis ("Big Mode") and cited cross-workspace synthesis ("Deep Research") directly inside Slack, no separate tool needed.

signals.title: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
signals.summary: Google's new speech-to-text model (362 HN pts) cuts word-error-rate to 2.6% and speeds transcription 70% vs its predecessor, plus auto-formatting, filler-word removal, and 3-speaker labeling.

signals.title: First outputs surface from OpenAI's next flagship, "GPT-6 Astra"
signals.summary: Early leaked/teased outputs ahead of any official release date suggest a real capability jump over GPT-5.6.

signals.title: Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard: agents that operate lab/factory equipment
signals.summary: Research-preview spec lets an agent orchestrate multiple lab/manufacturing instruments and self-correct errors in real time. Genentech/CMU/HHMI Janelia partners; not accessible to a small business yet.

signals.title: DeepSeek seeks $7.4B raise at a $74B valuation
signals.summary: Money-movement backdrop: one of the loudest open-weight labs raising a mega-round for R&D and compute buildout.

signals.title: Launch HN: Risklytics (YC S26), insurance brokerage for frontier tech companies
signals.summary: Still surfacing in HN searches this week; 54-point YC S26 launch, a niche insurance-broker wedge for AI-labs-adjacent companies.

signals.title: Launch HN: Salem Robotics (YC S26), software for industrial inspection robots
signals.summary: 49-point YC S26 launch; robotics inspection software, outside David's world but a data point on where YC S26 is placing bets.

signals.title: Wikipedia "AI agent" pageviews spiked, then partly faded
signals.summary: Daily views spiked to 2,555 on 2026-08-26 (the Hugging Face/OpenExecutive news week) then settled to a 1,200-1,600 plateau through 2026-08-30 — roughly 30-50% above the early-August baseline (~840-975), not the doubling trend last week's read implied once the single spike day is excluded.

signals.title: Mintlify puts account signup inside the CLI
signals.summary: Lets an agent create an account via a terminal command instead of a browser flow — a small but real data point on tools being redesigned for agents-as-users, not just humans.
